title: Vault assertions that isolate their failure condition
summary: Make reviewable regression cases fail for the behavior they claim, including staged interruption, diagnostics, retry source identity, and typed path and line checks.
acceptance_criteria: For each affected case, keep a valid control and demonstrate that disabling only its intended guard changes the outcome or that the observed signal uniquely identifies failure of the intended behavior.

evidence.claim: Cancellation must happen during the staged operation.
Recovery retry should prove a new source pin.
TypeScript line check must isolate invalid coordinates.
